title: Hearty British Sausages Toad In The Hole
description: A classic British dish featuring sausages cooked in a Yorkshire pudding batter, with a spicy twist from sriracha and bonito flakes, this recipe is high in protein and perfect for a filling meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, eggs, milk, salt, and black pepper to make the Yorkshire pudding batter.
Add the sriracha and bonito flakes to the batter and mix well.
Heat the vegetable oil in a 12-inch oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sausages to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Pour the Yorkshire pudding batter over the sausages in the skillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes, or until the pudding is golden brown and cooked through.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
